scope: Review Order page (/review-order) - Exactly 3 UI changes (Loyalty Points Row, Loading Skeleton, Earn Preview Section)

typography.font_family_body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

change_1_inline_loyalty_points_row.location: Inside ReviewOrderPriceBreakdown / Price Breakdown card, positioned directly between Coupon row and Subtotal row.
change_1_inline_loyalty_points_row.crm_api_context: POST /scan/max-redeemable returns max_points_redeemable, max_discount_value, available_points, min_points_threshold.

state_a_normal_redeemable.description: When server allows redeeming points up to max_points_redeemable cap.
state_a_normal_redeemable.button_style: Enabled warm orange pill button (bg-[#E8632B] text-white hover:bg-[#D5521C] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-full transition-colors)

state_b_after_use_tapped_applied.description: When user taps Use and loyalty discount is applied to the price breakdown.
state_b_after_use_tapped_applied.button_style: Outline/Ghost remove button (text-[#E8632B] hover:text-red-600 border border-[#FDCDBB] hover:border-red-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-full bg-orange-50/50 transition-colors)

state_c_not_available_below_min.description: When order subtotal or user balance is below CRM min redemption threshold.
state_c_not_available_below_min.button_style: Disabled greyed-out button (bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 border border-gray-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-full cursor-not-allowed)

change_2_loading_state.location: Same row position in Price Breakdown during in-flight POST /scan/max-redeemable CRM API call (<300ms).
change_2_loading_state.design_specification: Skeleton shimmer row preventing layout shift and flash of stale data.

structure.icon_skeleton: w-4 h-4 bg-gray-200 rounded animate-pulse mr-2
structure.button_skeleton: h-6 w-12 bg-gray-200 rounded-full animate-pulse ml-auto

change_3_earn_preview_section.location: LoyaltyRewardsSection located directly BELOW the price breakdown card on Review Order page.

copy.title: You will earn 150 points on this order!
copy.subtitle: Worth ₹450

styling.container: bg-[#FFF8F5] border border-[#FDCDBB] rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 shadow-xs mt-3

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement exactly the 3 specified UI changes on the Review Order page (/review-order) without altering other components or pages.
Ensure all 3 states of Change 1 (Normal, Applied, Below-Min) render smoothly based on CRM max-redeemable payload.
Use Change 2 Skeleton loader during in-flight POST /scan/max-redeemable API call to eliminate flash of stale content.
Update Change 3 LoyaltyRewardsSection to use authoritative projected_points_earned and worth amounts returned by CRM API.
Ensure every interactive and key informational element includes its designated data-testid attribute as defined in this specification.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Maintain brand primary #E8632B for primary actions; avoid dark gradient overload or unauthorized color shifts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.layout: Keep mobile-first narrow width (~390px) responsive layout with clean cards, clear dividers, and generous internal padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use explicit micro-interactions (hover, active, focus) with specific transition properties (avoid transition: all).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high contrast (APCA / WCAG AA min 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text) and include data-testid on all key UI elements.
